caseName: Harbor Tug & Barge Co. v. Papai
caseNameFull: Harbor Tug & Barge Co. v. Papai et ux.

opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. Motion of Industrial Indemnity Co. for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Certiorari granted. Brief of petitioner is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Tuesday, November 12, 1996. Brief of respondents is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Tuesday, December 10, 1996. A reply brief, if any, is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Friday, December 27, 1996. This Court’s Rule 29.2 does not apply.
